The supplement applies to England and Wales.

Not all land in England and Wales is currently registered.
Registered land is assigned a unique title number.
HM Land Registry's computerised index map is based on Ordnance Survey mapping.
The index map indexes land in every registered title.
The index map also indexes pending first-registration applications.
HM Land Registry does not hold title information for unregistered properties.
Any person may apply for an official search of the index map using form SIM.
A SIM certificate states whether the searched land is registered.
A SIM certificate identifies title numbers affecting the searched land.
A SIM certificate states the type of registration disclosed.
The index-map search service is separate from the official-copy service.
MapSearch is an alternative where index-map-search indemnity is not required.
MapSearch is available to Business e-services customers with portal access.
Illustrative Plans provide a colour-coded view of titles revealed by SIM results.
Multiple SIM results can be amalgamated on one Illustrative Plan.
An Illustrative Plan can help visualise unregistered land inside the original search area.
Illustrative Plans use the latest Ordnance Survey detail.
Illustrative Plans are available in A4, A3, A2, A1 and A0 paper sizes.
Electronic Extent Data polygons can be requested for a customer-defined electronic geographical area.
Electronic Extent Data polygons can be requested for specific title numbers.
Electronic Extent Data polygons can be requested for properties owned by a specified proprietor.
INSPIRE Index Polygons is described as an open-source dataset.
The dataset was developed to comply with the INSPIRE Directive.
The dataset contains locations of registered freehold property in England and Wales.
INSPIRE Index Polygons is a subset of HM Land Registry's Index Polygons database.
INSPIRE polygons are divided into separate files for each local-authority area.
A polygon crossing a local-authority boundary can appear in both authority files.
An INSPIRE polygon shows the indicative extent of a registered property.
An INSPIRE polygon shows the indicative position of a registered property.
Each INSPIRE polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID.
The Land Registry-INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title.
The INSPIRE ID can be used with Find a Property to obtain title registration and plan information.
The dataset is updated on the first Sunday of each month.
Each monthly publication represents data from the previous month.
Published files remain available until the following month's files replace them.
A GIS is required to view the downloaded INSPIRE GML files.
The current INSPIRE download page states that the dataset was published on 5 July 2026.
The download page organises polygon files by local authority.
Local-authority downloads are provided as GML files.
Downloading the files constitutes agreement to the Open Government Licence conditions of use.
The current download page lists London Borough of Haringey.
The current download page lists London Borough of Barnet.
The current download page lists London Borough of Enfield.
The download index contains a dedicated London-borough sequence under the letter L.
The July files are accessible until HM Land Registry updates the monthly publication.
The download page describes the files as spatial data showing indicative property extents and positions.
HM Land Registry describes GML as an open data format.
The GML format complies with the EU INSPIRE Directive.
